name: Aemulus Holdings Berhad
overview: Aemulus 与 Samsung Electro-Mechanics (SEMCO) 就 Silicon Capacitor 功能测试的合作备忘录已完成，双方关系转为由 SEMCO 按采购订单进行的商业供应关系；同时公司通过全资子公司 ACSB 完成对 TMSS 的收购，TMSS 保持为全资子公司。
overview_en: Aemulus's MOU with Samsung Electro-Mechanics (SEMCO) for Silicon Capacitor functionality testing has been completed, with the relationship progressing to a commercial supply relationship via purchase orders issued by SEMCO; meanwhile, the company completed the acquisition of TMSS through its wholly-owned subsidiary ACSB, and TMSS remains a wholly-owned subsidiary.

segments.name: 自动化测试设备
segments.note: 与 SEMCO 的 Silicon Capacitor 功能测试合作备忘录已完成，转为按采购订单进行的商业供应关系。
segments.note_en: The MOU with SEMCO for Silicon Capacitor functionality testing has been completed, transitioning to a commercial supply relationship via purchase orders.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Samsung Electro-Mechanics 的 Silicon Capacitor 功能测试合作备忘录已完成，双方关系转为由 SEMCO 按采购订单进行的商业供应关系。
actions.text_en: The MOU with Samsung Electro-Mechanics for Silicon Capacitor functionality testing has been completed, and the relationship has progressed to a commercial supply relationship transacted via purchase orders issued by SEMCO.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 双方正在讨论签订联合开发协议，以正式确定在 Silicon Capacitor 功能测试方面的合作并建立长期战略伙伴关系。
actions.text_en: The parties are in discussions to enter into a joint development agreement to formalise their collaboration and establish a strategic long-term partnership in Silicon Capacitor functionality testing.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: TMSS 增加注册资本授权已失效，TMSS 保持为 ACSB 的全资子公司。
segments.note_en: The authority for TMSS to increase its registered capital has lapsed, and TMSS remains a wholly-owned subsidiary of ACSB.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: TMSS 增加最多 60% 注册资本供第三方投资者认购的授权已失效（自收购代价全额支付起 12 个月），TMSS 保持为 ACSB 的全资子公司。
actions.text_en: The authority for TMSS to increase up to 60% of its enlarged registered capital for subscription by third-party investors has lapsed (12 months from full payment of the purchase consideration), and TMSS remains a wholly-owned subsidiary of ACSB.
